artifacts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Age of Fronts strategy game building icon, Modern Age military airstrip, transparent PNG, square 1254 x 1254.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its realistic hand-painted game icon finish, industrial roof detail, material grain, restrained colours, overhead geometry and bounded ground footprint. Create a new airfield, not a weapons factory.
Primary request: a compact military airstrip facility suitable for producing and operating WWII-era propeller aircraft.
Composition: STRICT VERTICAL TOP DOWN, camera directly overhead at 90 degrees, orthographic plan view. All roofs, runway and taxiway are seen from straight above. No isometric camera or perspective. One coherent compact airfield footprint entirely inside the square, with a comfortable transparent border.
Subject: one long straight narrow asphalt runway running vertically through the left half, with readable white dashed centreline, paired threshold bars and clear unobstructed ends. A parallel taxiway leads to a concrete apron on the right, connected to two simple corrugated metal aircraft hangars, seen as rectangular roof plans. A small flat-roof operations building, compact fuel storage and service area sit beside the hangars and clear of aircraft paths. Realistic grass strips and gravel margins frame the asphalt. Simple perimeter boundary only on the service side, never across runway ends. Service roads connect sensibly. Facility silhouettes should be readable at strategy-map scale.
Materials and colours: weathered charcoal asphalt, pale concrete, grey corrugated steel hangar roofs with visible seams and a few skylights, olive equipment, muted green grass, subtle ochre taxiway lines. Rich tactile textures and soft compact ambient shading, same polish as the reference.
Constraints: single facility only, no aircraft included because separate aircraft sprites will be made, no people, no vehicles blocking the runway, no labels, words, runway numerals, logos or watermark. No large visible walls, front facades, front hangar door elevations or tall tower sides. A true top-down roof map rather than an aerial oblique illustration. Outside the compact grounded footprint must be genuinely transparent alpha, never a painted white or checkerboard background.

artifacts.subject: four-engine WWII-era heavy bomber
artifacts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Age of Fronts strategy game aircraft unit icon, square transparent PNG, final 627 x 627 pixels.
Input image 1: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for realistically painted game icon finish, restrained grey/olive palette, detailed weathered metal, sharp roof-map-like overhead geometry and soft ambient highlights. Do not include any building, paving, scenery or ground from this reference.
Camera: perfectly vertical 90-degree TOP DOWN orthographic plan view, looking down on the upper surfaces of the airplane. Aircraft flies level, wings horizontal, nose pointing straight toward the top of the canvas, tail pointing down. No roll, no bank, no pitch, no perspective foreshortening, no isometric tilt, no visible fuselage side wall or underside.
Style: polished realistic hand-painted 2D game sprite, matching the building set's textured surface treatment. Restrained olive-drab painted upper surfaces, slightly worn panel edges, a little exposed aluminium, subtle rivets and seams, dark glazed cockpit panels. Use material highlights to read volume, but no detached ground shadow.
Composition: one complete centered aircraft silhouette, wings entirely in frame, balanced left and right, comfortable transparent margins on every side, nose and tail intact. Crisp useful silhouette at small game-map scale.
Constraints: genuine transparent alpha outside the aircraft, no ground tile, sky, clouds, motion trails, environment, text, national insignia, logos, labels, numbers, people or watermark. ONE AIRPLANE ONLY. Conventional WWII propeller-era construction and silhouette, no jet engine or modern swept delta wing. Avoid toy proportions, schematic diagram styling or flat line art.
Subject: a single WWII-era four-engine heavy bomber airplane. A long substantial olive-drab fuselage with a glazed rounded bomber nose, dark framed cockpit glazing near the front, broad straight gently tapered symmetric wings, EXACTLY FOUR conventional propeller engine nacelles, two under each wing evenly spaced and equally sized, each extending a short way ahead of its wing leading edge. Correct overhead propeller projection at each engine. Conventional horizontal tailplane and a single vertical tail seen only as a narrow center ridge, a small dark dorsal gun turret glass dome. Landing gear retracted, bomb bay closed, no loose bombs. The wingspan occupies about 86 percent of the canvas width and is noticeably wider than fuselage length. Every engine and wing connection should be coherent, readable and symmetrical.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: top-down aerial bomb game icon for Age of Fronts, WWII-era aircraft payload, one individual bomb, square transparent PNG, final 627 x 627 pixels.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the realistic hand-painted game asset finish, muted olive and grey metal, readable overhead geometry, weathered surface grain and subtle lighting. No factory, buildings, weapons bench, crates or environment.
Primary request: a single conventional WWII-style aerial bomb that would be dropped from a bomber, seen directly from above with its full longitudinal body silhouette visible.
Composition: true orthographic overhead plan view, bomb lying horizontally in the imaginary image plane, length oriented vertically on the canvas with rounded streamlined nose at the top and tail fins at the bottom. The imaginary support surface is absent. One complete centered bomb fills about 80 percent of the canvas height, with generous clear transparent margins, clean readable silhouette.
Subject and details: one olive-drab steel aerial bomb, tapered rounded ogive nose, robust cylindrical middle body narrowing to a finned tail. Conventional symmetrical steel cruciform stabilizing tail fin assembly, with correct straight-above projection: the horizontal pair spreads left and right and the vertical fin is a thin central ridge. Tidy coherent manufacture, visible panel seams, lightly worn painted metal edges and discreet yellow identification band. No readable codes, words, numbering or labels.
Style: polished realistic hand-painted 2D strategy-game sprite, moderate tactile surface detail and restrained highlights that read well at small size, same material realism as the reference assets.
Constraints: only ONE bomb, no explosion, fire, sparks, falling trail, airplane, detached ground shadow, display pedestal, ground tile or environmental scenery. No text, logo, watermark or schematic cutaway. No isometric view, perspective tilt or large visible side elevation. Genuinely transparent alpha outside the bomb silhouette, never a white or checkerboard painted background.
